gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G21: GRADE THE MATCH, PRE-REGISTER THE NULL. On this instrument `find_matched` is a boolean over the whole tag-stripped body while the excerpt is centred on the FIRST occurrence, so A MATCH ESTABLISHES OCCURRENCE AND NEVER LOCATION. (a) A conclusion that depends ONLY on occurrence - a positive control, a digest pair, the G18 bracket - MAY be pre-registered on a match. (b) A conclusion that depends on WHERE the literal landed MAY NOT be pre-registered on a match; it is graded at read time. (c) A null branch MAY be pre-registered, because added text cannot remove an occurrence and chrome therefore cannot produce a false null. A NULL IS CHROME-SAFE, NOT SAFE. (d) Where a presence-branch is graded at read time, the licence states in advance what this project's chrome holdings for that host do and do not cover. NO PRESENCE-BRANCH IS PRE-REGISTERED ON A MATCH ANYWHERE IN THIS BATCH.
